summary.zh: 满屏的小点，指针经过时附近的点被推开、变大、染上强调色，离开后用弹簧晃回原位。没有指针时有个看不见的游标自己在逛。
summary.en: A field of dots; near the pointer they get pushed away, grow and pick up the accent color, then spring back. With no pointer, an invisible wanderer drifts around.

technique.zh: Canvas 2D，每个点存原位/当前位置/速度；目标 = 原位 + 沿远离指针方向的推力 × smoothstep(1-距离/半径)；弹簧积分追过去。设备像素比最高取 2。
technique.en: Canvas 2D; each dot keeps home, position and velocity; target = home + push along the away vector × smoothstep(1 − d/r), chased by a spring. DPR capped at 2.

adapt.zh: 当背景用时把 canvas 放到内容下面（z-index:-1），颜色在 :root 里改。
adapt.en: As a backdrop, put the canvas under your content (z-index:-1); colors live in :root.
